dialogue.origin: (こんばんは。時間になったら 始めますね。よろしくおねがいします）
dialogue.content: (Good evening. We'll start when it's time. I look forward to working with you.)

dialogue.origin: こんばんは、よろしくお願いいたします。ちょっとパソコンの調子が悪くて返信遅れるかもしれません。すみません。
dialogue.content: Good evening, I look forward to our session. My computer is acting up a bit, so my replies might be delayed. I'm sorry about that.

dialogue.origin: （はい。わかりました）
dialogue.content: (Yes, understood.)

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。相談員です。
dialogue.content: Hello. I'm your counselor.

dialogue.origin: （パソコン大丈夫そうです。お願いします）
dialogue.content: (My computer seems to be fine now. Let's begin.)

dialogue.origin: 初めに、よろしかったら、お年と性別を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: To begin, if you're comfortable, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.origin: 40歳女性です
dialogue.content: I'm a 40-year-old woman.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどんなご相談ですか？
dialogue.content: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.origin: 会社の人間関係に悩んでいます
dialogue.content: I'm struggling with relationships at work.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんな人間関係に悩んでいらっしゃるか、教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: Could you tell me more about the relationship issues you're facing?

dialogue.origin: 1人、私に対して当たりが強くてどう接していいかわかりません
dialogue.content: There's one person who is very harsh with me, and I don't know how to interact with them.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...それはおつらいですよね
dialogue.content: I see... That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.origin: お話してくれてありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.origin: いつごろから、今のようなご状況なんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How long has this situation been going on?

dialogue.origin: 3カ月前に転職したのですが、最初から厳しいです。というか、良い時はいいんですけど、お天気やというか、何かあるとすぐ私に突っかかってきます
dialogue.content: I changed jobs three months ago, and it's been tough from the start. I mean, when things are good, they're good, but this person is very moody, and they'll lash out at me at the slightest thing.

dialogue.origin: 良い時と悪い時の差が激しくて怖くもあります
dialogue.content: The difference between their good moods and bad moods is so extreme that it's scary.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか...それはなんとも理不尽な感じがします...
dialogue.content: I see... That sounds very unfair...

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: Yes, it does.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね...それでは日々休まらないですよね
dialogue.content: I can imagine... That would make it hard to feel at ease day to day.

dialogue.origin: はい、なんで怒られるかわからない内容の時もあるので苦手です
dialogue.content: Yes, sometimes I get scolded and I don't even know why, so I find it hard to deal with.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。う～ん...おつらいですね..睡眠やお食事はとれていますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Hmm... that sounds very stressful. Are you able to sleep and eat properly?

dialogue.origin: 色々あった日は、腹が立って眠れない時もありますが、食欲はあります。でも仕事行く前などお腹が痛くなったりします
dialogue.content: On days when a lot has happened, sometimes I get so angry I can't sleep, but my appetite is fine. However, I sometimes get a stomachache before going to work.

dialogue.origin: そうですか...
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 体にも影響が出ているんですね
dialogue.content: So it's starting to affect you physically.

dialogue.origin: そんな時にお話に来てくれてありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming to talk to me during such a difficult time.

dialogue.origin: いえいえ・・・なので仕事辞めようかなとか最近考え始めました。
dialogue.content: Not at all... That's why I've recently started thinking about quitting my job.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: それほどストレスフルだということなんですね..
dialogue.content: It sounds like it's that stressful for you...

dialogue.origin: どなたか会社の中でご相談してますか？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to anyone at the company about this?

dialogue.origin: はい、私が悪くて怒られる分には全然平気なのですが。理不尽なことも多く、少し馬鹿にされているようにも感じるので・・・
dialogue.content: I'm fine with being scolded if I'm the one at fault. But it's often unreasonable, and I also feel like I'm being belittled...

dialogue.origin: 会社では相談していません
dialogue.content: I haven't talked to anyone at the company.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね..
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: 事務の仕事で私含めて、4人いるのですが、他の２人とは仲良くやっているので、その人の悪口とかは言えません
dialogue.content: There are four of us in the office, including me, and I get along well with the other two, so I can't really say bad things about this person.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか..それではなおさら、行き詰ってしまいますよね
dialogue.content: I see... That must make you feel even more stuck.

dialogue.origin: 当たってくる人というのは、どういう立場なのですか？
dialogue.content: What is this person's position in the company?

dialogue.origin: 私は契約社員なのですが、その人はパートさんです。でも勤めて５年位で大変な仕事をまかされているのでどうしても、その人に習ったりその人の仕事を引き継いでいるので関らないといけません
dialogue.content: I'm a contract employee, and she's a part-timer. But she's been there for about five years and is entrusted with difficult tasks, so I have to learn from her and take over her work, which means I have to interact with her.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...
dialogue.content: I see...

dialogue.origin: それはやり場がないですね
dialogue.content: That leaves you with nowhere to turn.

dialogue.origin: ４人でご一緒に、ということでしたが
dialogue.content: You mentioned there are four of you working together...

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: その人は他の人にはどんな対応なんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How does she treat the others?

dialogue.origin: 他の２人はその当たってくる人の先輩にあたるので、結構気さくに話しています
dialogue.content: The other two are senior to her, so she talks to them quite casually.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: だから私に言いやすいのはわかるのですが・・・
dialogue.content: So I understand why it's easy for her to pick on me, but...

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I understand.

dialogue.origin: 大変な我慢をされているんですね
dialogue.content: You've been putting up with a lot.

dialogue.origin: ...しんどいですよね...
dialogue.content: ...It must be very tough...

dialogue.origin: おなかが痛いこともありながら、よくお仕事にいかれていらっしゃいますね
dialogue.content: You've been doing so well to keep going to work, even with the stomachaches.

dialogue.origin: そうですね・・・一応生活もあるので仕事を休む訳にはいきませんから・・・
dialogue.content: Yes... I have to make a living, so I can't afford to miss work...

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか...
dialogue.content: I understand...

dialogue.origin: でも、最近本当我慢の限界がきそうです
dialogue.content: But lately, I really feel I'm reaching my limit.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: I can imagine.

dialogue.origin: もっともだと思います
dialogue.content: That makes perfect sense.

dialogue.origin: これ以上は、心身ともに崩れてしまいそうに感じます
dialogue.content: It feels like any more of this could take a toll on you, both mentally and physically.

dialogue.origin: ご家族にはお話されていますか？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to your family about this?

dialogue.origin: はい、家族にはいつも愚痴ってます。相手は完璧主義者なので、たいしたことないミスもあたかも大きなミスしたように言ってきたり、就業時間が終わっているのに長文メールで文句言ってきたりしてきます。そのメールも私がなぜ悪いか分からないメール本当ムカつくので家族にメール
dialogue.content: Yes, I complain to my family all the time. She's a perfectionist, so she'll make a big deal out of minor mistakes as if they were major ones, and she'll send me long complaint emails after work hours. Those emails are so infuriating because I don't even understand what I did wrong, so I show them to my family.

dialogue.origin: みせたりしてます
dialogue.content: I show them.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。ご家族にお話しできているのは少しほっとしました
dialogue.content: I see. I'm a little relieved to hear you're able to talk to your family about it.

dialogue.origin: それにしても...ひどいですね
dialogue.content: Even so... that’s awful.

dialogue.origin: そうですね・・・本当嫌になってきます
dialogue.content: Yes... I’m really getting fed up with it.

dialogue.origin: そうですね...ハラスメントですよね
dialogue.content: Yes... That sounds like harassment.

dialogue.origin: 会社の方にはお話ししていないということでしたが...
dialogue.content: You mentioned you haven't spoken to anyone at the company...

dialogue.origin: 人事や産業医など、ご検討されたことはありますか？
dialogue.content: Have you considered talking to HR or an occupational physician?

dialogue.origin: 個人がやっている会社なので、相談する人はいません。女社長なのですが、社長も変わり者で嫌いな人にはとことん冷たくて、対応がひどいです。でも社長には相談しました。社長はその人に対してすごく怒ってくれたのですが、怒り方がひどいので逆に私がひどいことしたなと心苦しくなりました
dialogue.content: It's a privately-owned company, so there's no one to talk to. The president is a woman, but she's a bit eccentric; she's very cold and treats people she dislikes terribly. But I did talk to her. She got very angry at the person on my behalf, but the way she got angry was so severe that it made me feel guilty, as if I had done something terrible.

dialogue.origin: そうでしたか...それでは八方ふさがりですね
dialogue.content: I see... It sounds like you're trapped with no way out.

dialogue.origin: お話しようと考えられないのも当然ですよね
dialogue.content: It's natural that you wouldn't feel you can talk to anyone.

dialogue.origin: でも、社長から言われても、自覚ないみたいで、ぜんぜん改善されていません
dialogue.content: But even after being told off by the president, she doesn't seem to be self-aware, and her behavior hasn't improved at all.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね...
dialogue.content: I understand...

dialogue.origin: 今、どんなお気持ちですか？
dialogue.content: How are you feeling right now?

dialogue.origin: もう少し平和に仕事がしたいだけなのでどうにかならないかなぁって思っています
dialogue.content: I just want to be able to work in peace, so I'm wondering if there's anything that can be done.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: お話を少し整理してもよろしいですか？
dialogue.content: Would it be alright if I summarize what you've told me?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 3か月前に転職されて以来、一緒に仕事をしている４人のうちのひとりが当たりがきつく、お天気やで就業後も長文メールで文句を言ってきたりする。ほかの二人とは仲がいいようなので、相談できず、女社長に言ったものの、怒ってくれたけど、かえって強い当たりになってしまった。体調にも影響があり、やめたいと思うようになってきたが、生活もあり、休むこともせず、出勤されている
dialogue.content: Since you changed jobs three months ago, one of the four people you work with has been harsh and moody, even sending long complaint emails after work. You can't talk to the other two colleagues about her, since they seem to get along. You did speak to the female president, who got angry on your behalf, but her reaction was so severe that it made you feel distressed. This is affecting your health and you've started thinking about quitting, but because you need to make a living, you've continued to go to work without taking time off.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 失礼しました。怒ってくれたことを、ひどいおこりかただったので、あなたが苦しく思ってしまわれている..でしたね
dialogue.content: My apologies. It was that the president's scolding was so severe that it made you feel distressed... is that correct?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: 本当にそんなことをされても気を使われているんですね
dialogue.content: You're still being considerate of others even after being treated that way.

dialogue.origin: 優しい方だからこそ、すべてひきうけてしまっているんですね
dialogue.content: It's because you're a kind person that you end up shouldering everything.

dialogue.origin: ...やめたいということでしたが
dialogue.content: ...You mentioned you were thinking of quitting,

dialogue.origin: そのお話はご家族にしていますか？
dialogue.content: Have you talked to your family about that?

dialogue.origin: 言ってます。夫はいいんじゃない？って言ってくれてますけど、就活は大変なので本当は長くやっていきたいのは本音です
dialogue.content: I have. My husband says it would be fine if I did, but job hunting is hard, so honestly, I'd really like to stay for the long term.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: いろいろなお気持ちがあると思いますが、どうなったらいいと思いますか？
dialogue.content: I imagine you have many conflicting feelings, but what would be the ideal outcome for you?

dialogue.origin: 仕事は嫌いではないし、他の2人は面白いのでできれば、その人が私に対して態度を改めてくれたら別に問題はないのですが・・・
dialogue.content: I don't dislike the job, and the other two colleagues are fun, so if that one person could just change her attitude towards me, there wouldn't be a problem...

dialogue.origin: そうですよね...
dialogue.content: That makes sense...

dialogue.origin: お話をうかがっていると...
dialogue.content: From what I'm hearing...

dialogue.origin: その人も何か大きなストレスを抱えていらっしゃるように思いますが...
dialogue.content: It sounds like that person might be under a lot of stress herself...

dialogue.origin: 例えばなのですが...
dialogue.content: For example...

dialogue.origin: ほかの二人に、どうやったらうまくいくか、相談してみるのは難しいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be difficult to ask the other two for advice on how to get along better with her?

dialogue.origin: そうですね・・・。何度か言おうと思ったのですが、３人は仲良いので、言いにくいですよね。でもちょっと相談してみます
dialogue.content: Well... I've thought about it a few times, but the three of them get along well, so it's hard to bring up. But I'll try talking to them a little.

dialogue.origin: それでダメなら仕事辞めてもいいし
dialogue.content: If that doesn't work, I can just quit.

dialogue.origin: そうですね...一方的なお話にならないようお願いして..というところがポイントかなと思うのですが
dialogue.content: Right... I think the key would be to ask them in a way that doesn't make it a one-sided complaint...

dialogue.origin: しつれいしました
dialogue.content: Excuse me, I interrupted.

dialogue.origin: おやめになる前に
dialogue.content: Before you decide to quit,

dialogue.origin: 上手く間を取り持っていただけるといいかなと思うのですが...
dialogue.content: I think it would be good if they could mediate for you...

dialogue.origin: ２人は私の事分かってくれているとは思います。メールの事とかは知らないですが、結構私の事も可愛がってくれるので相談にはのってもらえると思います
dialogue.content: I think the two of them understand me. They don't know about the emails and everything, but they are quite fond of me, so I think they would be willing to listen.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。あなたは優しい方なので、みんなで仲良くできることが一番のぞましいのではないかと思いました
dialogue.content: I see. You strike me as a kind person, so I felt that what you wish for most is for everyone to be able to get along.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございます
dialogue.content: No, thank you.

dialogue.origin: それでもうまくいかなかったら
dialogue.content: If that still doesn't work out...

dialogue.origin: またご相談に来ていただければご一緒に考えたいと思います
dialogue.content: please feel free to come back and we can think it through together.

dialogue.origin: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: How does that sound?

dialogue.origin: はい、そうします。
dialogue.content: Yes, I'll do that.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 本日のご相談はいったん終了してよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Would it be alright to conclude our session for today?

dialogue.origin: はい、ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそ、今日はありがとうございました。応援していますので、お体に気を付けてくださいね
dialogue.content: Thank you as well for today. I'm rooting for you, so please take care of yourself.

dialogue.origin: はい、では失礼します
dialogue.content: Okay, goodbye then.

dialogue.origin: （これでロールプレイを終了してもよろしいでしょうか？）
dialogue.content: (Shall we end the role-play here?)

dialogue.origin: （お疲れさまでした。終了で大丈夫です！ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for your time. It’s fine to end here! Thank you very much.)

dialogue.origin: （電波が悪く、風車回り、返信遅れてすみませんでした。ありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (The connection was poor and the loading spinner kept turning, so I'm sorry my replies were delayed. Thank you very much.)

topic.sub: 契約社員としての人間関係のストレス
